svg.title: Actual central kitchen task lighting check
svg.desc: Source-derived geometric review. Luminaire symbols show placement and intended use, not measured light distribution or accepted materials.
svg.text: The kitchen tests the limit of the lamp preference
Actual table, occupied worker, sink and cooking footprints · no kitchen layout change
No portable flex across occupied circulation, wet work or the hob. Wall-only central performance remains unmeasured.
Use ordinary switching and a cleanable, replaceable source on an independent surface support; no whole ceiling lining.
750 mm table task plane is authored, not measured. Confirm actual ceiling/table height, shadows, glare and cleaning.
Retain separate sink/hob/hood task duties. This is a transferability screen, not a lighting performance pass.
